verdict.rationale: Nitrokey is a hardware security key, so its programmatic surface is device-level rather than a web API. It ships an official Python SDK on PyPI (nitrokey 0.4.2) and a documented nitropy CLI, and a hands-on user praises its dev tools, documentation and OpenSC integration. However, no API reference for the SDK is shown, no OpenAPI spec exists (probes 404), and a user reports attestation certs cannot be exported via PKCS#11 and require a custom vendor shell. missing for 10: documented SDK/API reference evidence, complete coverage through standard interfaces (e.g. PKCS#11 attestation export), independent corroboration of driving Nitrokey 3 programmatically via the SDK

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can drive the product through a documented public API
